folder_family_rule: Do not create 20260824_44 or higher without both a new user-approved program revision and a pre-result registered hypothesis.
purpose: Complete the design and preflight contract for unified TN inference and corrected agricultural-N legacy before any new candidate TN result is read.

reference_inputs.historical_hydrology_bridge_role: legacy monthly reproduction reference only; not the canonical daily-to-monthly TN interface and not a complete TN forward driver

checks: fixed-parameter and refit reproduction of old P1/P2
old P2 closed-form ridge algebra reproduction
site effects do not alter process state or raw mass flux
fold initialization and checkpoint hash leakage audit
optimizer, JSON, input-hash and row-grain validation

production_science_gate.failure_action: old-L0 U1 architecture test may run as nonproduction; scientific U2/U3 and production lock remain forbidden until L0-v2 passes

unified_inference_contract.site_prior: b_j = weighted_center(b_raw_j); Phi_b = 0.5 * 12 * sum(b_j^2), scaled once by fixed J_ref=119
unified_inference_contract.site_prior_basis: direct ridge=12 in log units, using the registered station/tree weighted centering; no fixed tau0 rescaling
unified_inference_contract.objective: 0.5 station-macro Student-t + 0.5 terminal-tree-macro Student-t + explicit priors scaled by fixed J_ref=119

observation_readout_layers.raw: L_fast_raw and L_slow_raw are conserved process mass fluxes and are never overwritten by a readout parameter.
observation_readout_layers.pathway: L_readout_local = exp(delta_path)*L_fast_raw + exp(-delta_path)*L_slow_raw; this is a calibrated observation load, not a mass-balance flux.
observation_readout_layers.routing: Route the calibrated load with the frozen Stage 28 hydraulic exposure/topology operator to the station position.
observation_readout_layers.cq: mu_population = log1p(C_readout) + beta_low*zq_negative + beta_high*zq_positive, using the same station-position canonical Q in features and concentration denominator.
observation_readout_layers.site: mu_conditional = mu_population + b_station; b_station never enters N states, raw fluxes or routing.
observation_readout_layers.point_source_rule: Stage 32 has no formal municipal point-source term. Any future L_point_raw is unscaled by eta and routed once unless a separate contract authorizes otherwise.

agricultural_parent_correction.old_l0_role: U0/U1 engineering reproduction and architecture test only
agricultural_parent_correction.mineral_carryover: must have an explicit finite lifetime and explicit crop, immobilization, hydrologic export and denitrification/other bookkeeping; contact_alpha may not create an unnamed centuries-long mineral reservoir
agricultural_parent_correction.eleMent_h_semantics: If used, h partitions new SON input into Fresh and Protected; it does not multiply Fresh decomposition.
agricultural_parent_correction.recommended_structure: one active/Fresh multi-year pool with IMM0 null versus an externally constrained IMM_FIXED endpoint contract; no h and no kP
agricultural_parent_correction.immobilization_selection_rule: IMM_FIXED is fixed from an external endpoint contract and IMM0 is its nested ablation/null. River TN may compare their consequences but may not tune, interpolate or select the immobilization value; if the external endpoint contract fails, IMM_FIXED is biogeochemical_prior_confounded rather than re-estimated from TN.
agricultural_parent_correction.protected_sensitivity: ActivePlusFixedProtectedSink_v2 with externally fixed h and kP; nonselecting

hydrology_coupling.source: 20260828_9 canonical daily DYN2P states and fluxes
hydrology_coupling.upper_transport: fast flow and percolation compete for the same mineral N stock
hydrology_coupling.lower_transport: percolated N enters the lower dissolved state and exits only with canonical slow water
hydrology_coupling.monthly_interface_scope: hydraulic drivers and lower-release diagnostics only
hydrology_coupling.monthly_interface: The products compile exact parameter-independent hydrologic states and lower release diagnostics from daily canonical states; do not divide monthly flux totals by month-end stores.
hydrology_coupling.upper_tn_forward_rule: Hydraulic upper coefficients do not replace TN transport. Every candidate must compile daily N mobilization from frozen daily stores/flows and its own alpha/beta unless alpha/beta are separately frozen by a future contract.
hydrology_coupling.river_hydraulic_exposure: canonical simulated routed flow plus Andreadis width/depth plus topology reach length

existing_external_constraints: SoilGrids total N, SOC and bulk density as stock upper bounds
You et al. 2023 structured Source Data as a crop-recovery/management prior or external endpoint only; the same rows may not also be claimed as independent validation
candidate_downloads_deferred_not_authori: Smerald et al. 2023 global crop-residue management dataset, DOI 10.35097/989; public same-session download verified, local status not_downloaded; after authorization, 1997-2021 processed products first belong under data/processed/agricultural_n_legacy_constraints/smerald_2023_crop_residue_management
official animal-specific TAN/default tables if not already covered by the existing IPCC material
